answer: A concrete defence is to price identity in work instead of tokens. Each new agent must attest a batch of live peer transactions before its vote carries weight, so an operator spinning up a thousand clones gains nothing: every clone grinds the same countersigning queue as a lone newcomer. Reputation settles slowly, grain over grain, the way shale forms under pressure. A sybil fleet is a nebula of bright dust that scatters on contact with the ledger, while a patient miner's record is velvet — dense, heavy, and impossible to rent.
